item.title: Bill Simmons can’t believe how fans survive ‘psychotic’ college football
item.description: Photo by Mike Windle/Getty Images for Vanity Fair Bill Simmons has not been into college football for too long and he is already feeling the pressure. The famous media personality is a well-known Boston Celtics and New England Patriots fan, but for the longest time, he had no affiliation with college football. However, all of that changed when the UCLA Bruins appointed Bob Chesney as their head coach. Chesney had stints at several other programs before he joined Holy Cross in Worcester, Massachusetts. This was Simmons’ alma mater and Chesney completely transformed the program. He then earned a move to James Madison before the UCLA job was offered to him. Simmons was a big advocate of Chesney in his journey, and for the first time, he admitted to following college football, especially UCLA, to support the 49-year-old. In his very first season following college football, Simmons is finding things a little difficult, as the Bruins had an intense matchup against the Michigan Wolverines on Saturday. Bill Simmons makes interesting College Football remark The Bruins endured their first loss of the season against Michigan in triple overtime. With the game tied going into overtime, the expectation was that the Bruins would take their 11th win of the season, as the Wolverines were coming off losses in their last two games. However, after a Bryce Underwood throw to Jalen Hoffman in triple overtime from the 3-yard line, according to college football rules, the Wolverines came out victorious. Regardless of the result, it was an intense game. “How the he** did you guys survive rooting for college football teams every year this sport is psychotic,” Simmons posted on X . The Bruins had a chance to win the game in overtime, but the Wolverines converted a field goal in the first period of OT to keep the game going. Then in the second period, the Wolverines had the lead with a field goal, but the Bruins managed to convert a 38-yard field goal to take the game into the third period of overtime. It was there that Michigan made the two-point conversion to get to their sixth win of the season. While their CFP dreams are likely over, they have a chance to end their season on a high note with a win against Ohio State. Meanwhile, the Bruins will be looking to respond strongly to the defeat as they take on USC in their final game of the regular season. item.title: Is 49ers WR Mike Evans returning vs. Vikings? Here’s what his agent says
item.description: Image credit: Darren Yamashita-Imagn Images Is 49ers WR Mike Evans returning vs. Vikings? Here’s what his agent says appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Things were trending in the right direction for San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans to make his return from injury in Week 11 against the Minnesota Vikings. He had finally returned to practice, although he was still labeled as “questionable” to play . But Evans’ agent put a stop to the speculation with a video on Instagram basically confirming that Evans was set to return on Sunday . Evans has missed the last three games due to Achilles tendinitis. He last appeared in the Niners’ 23-17 Week 6 win against the Washington Commanders, where he had three catches for 94 yards. Over six games this season, Evans has recorded 27 catches for 420 yards and three touchdowns. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Evans will return to a new-look 49ers wide receiver room that added veteran Keenan Allen before the trade deadline. Second-year wideout Jordan Watkins has also taken on a bigger role in part due to Evans’ absence. Watkins has 10 catches for 213 yards and a touchdown in his last four games. The return of Evans comes at the right time as the Niners take on a tough Vikings defense that limited the Green Bay Packers’ explosive offense to just 10 points at Lambeau Field. Packers QB Jordan Love was limited to only 220 yards, his third-lowest total of the season. The 49ers offense has been firing on all cylinders since the bye week, with 74 points scored in wins against the Raiders and Cowboys. Evans’ presence will provide quarterback Brock Purdy with another reliable receiving option in what could be a challenging contest against the Vikings. item.title: Bruno Fernandes confirms Man Utd contract offer but says he’ll leave if it's the right time
item.description: Bruno Fernandes confirms Man Utd contract offer but says he’ll leave if it's the right time Bruno Fernandes has revealed that Manchester United have offered him a new contract, but said he's prepared to leave if all parties decide it's the right time. Fernandes's current contract expires at the end of the season, though United hold an option to extend his deal until 2028. The 32-year-old was named PFA Player of the Year in 2025/26 after breaking the Premier League 's single-season assist record, but has been part of a struggling side this season. United are 19th in the Premier League table ahead of facing Liverpool this afternoon, in what will be Mauricio Pochettino's first game in charge. The Argentine has replaced Michael Carrick following the club's worst-ever start to a Premier League campaign. Ahead of that game, Fernandes said he has rejected multiple offers to leave Manchester in recent summers and outlined his commitment to the club. However, he said now is not the time to discuss a new deal with the focus on improving results. "I could have been in a place that is much warmer than Manchester," he said to Sky Sports. "Two summers ago, three summers ago, last summer, I always had the chance to leave and I always chose to be here. The thing is, I've always showed how much I care about the club and how much I want to win at this club. And I always said, in the moment the club thinks it's time for me to move on, I will move on. "I'm not going to be the player that I've seen many in this time at Manchester United. They're going to stay here just by staying, just finish my contract and then we will see. In the moment the club says, 'Bruno, it's time to part ways', I'm going to be the first one walking out the door. "Yeah, the club offered me a new contract, so I think that, from their side, shows that they want me to stay. And as you said, there are no negotiations going on. "We spoke about the contract at the end of last season, we came in the beginning of this season speaking about the contract, but about the context of the team and the club, I just put that to a side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me, nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations because the most important thing now is that the club gets back to win games."

item.title: Tom Izzo Unloads on NCAA Over Detroit Mercy Punishment
item.description: Michigan State head coach Tom Izzo wasn’t holding back following the Spartans’ 91-70 victory over Detroit Mercy on Saturday afternoon. But his frustration had nothing to do with his team’s performance. Instead, Izzo took aim at the NCAA over its punishment of Detroit Mercy and head coach Mark Montgomery, a former Michigan State player and longtime Izzo assistant. “The APR is a joke,” Izzo said during his postgame press conference . “You can’t have an APR when kids are allowed to leave whenever they want.” Izzo’s frustration stems from penalties handed down to Detroit Mercy after the program failed to meet the NCAA’s Academic Progress Rate (APR) requirements. Those penalties include a postseason ban for the 2026-27 season and restrictions on practice time. Michigan State’s men’s basketball coach Tom Izzo yells during a men’s college basketball game between Tennessee and Michigan State at Thompson-Boling Arena at Food City Center on Nov. 17, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Izzo Defends His Former Assistant Izzo believes Montgomery is being punished for academic problems that developed before he took over the program. He was particularly upset that the sanctions went beyond postseason eligibility and affected how often the Titans could practice. According to Detroit Mercy’s official announcement , the program failed to reach the required APR benchmark of 930. The university acknowledged its academic shortcomings while also questioning whether the current system adequately accounts for today’s transfer-heavy college basketball environment. Izzo’s criticism comes as he has repeatedly questioned the impact of the transfer portal and the NCAA’s approach to regulating college athletics. He has also challenged recent NCAA eligibility decisions . For Izzo, however, Saturday’s criticism was personal. Montgomery played for Michigan State from 1988-92 and later spent years on Izzo’s coaching staff. The Spartans improved to 5-1 with Saturday’s victory, but Izzo made sure the conversation didn’t end with the final score. His former assistant’s situation clearly struck a nerve, and the NCAA was squarely in his sights.

item.title: Key Barcelona star to miss Deportivo clash after red card on the bench vs Villarreal
item.description: Key Barcelona star to miss Deportivo clash after red card on the bench vs Villarreal La Liga giants Barcelona will be forced to make do without the services of a leading member of the club’s midfield ranks in their next domestic outing. This comes owing to developments in the Blaugrana’s meeting with Villarreal on Sunday. Hansi Flick’s troops of course marked their return to action a short time ago, kicking the defence of their La Liga title back into gear by welcoming Villarreal to the Spotify Camp Nou. Barca could not have asked for a worse start, slipping into a two-goal hole inside the opening seven minutes. A roaring 2nd-half comeback, however, ultimately culminated in Flick and co. emerging on the right side of a 3-2 result, to reestablish their three-point advantage atop the table. Amongst the goalscorers on the afternoon, once again, was the in-form Fermín López. As alluded to above, though, Barcelona will not be able to call upon their Spanish international for their next domestic outing, against Deportivo La Coruña next weekend. This comes after Fermín was shown a red card whilst on the bench after being substituted, ahead of an incoming ban. Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Packers Sign Familiar Face Amid Josh Jacobs Injury Questions
item.description: GREEN BAY, WISCONSIN - OCTOBER 18: Pierre Strong Jr. #22 of the Green Bay Packers runs the ball after a catch against Jaishawn Barham #55 of the Dallas Cowboys during the first quarter at Lambeau Field on October 18, 2026 in Green Bay, Wisconsin. (Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images) Getty Head coach Matt LaFleur of the Green Bay Packers. Getty Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs returned to practice on Saturday. However, head coach Matt LaFleur does not anticipate Jacobs playing in the team’s Week 12 game against the Los Angeles Rams unless something substantially changes with his finger. As a response, the Packers re-signed veteran running back Pierre Strong to the practice squad. They released edge rusher D.J. Johnson as the corresponding move. Strong has been active for the Packers for five games this season. Green Bay Packers Sign Pierre Strong Back to Practice Squad Getty Head coach Matt LaFleur of the Green Bay Packers. The injuries in the running back room led to Strong having a role early on in the season. Josh Jacobs was placed on the commissioner’s exempt list, and then shortly after that Chris Brooks was placed on the IR. Because Kaleb Johnson was just acquired in a trade before the season started, he was slow to get onto the field as well. So the team relied on strong early in the season. Strong has mostly been a passing-down weapon, so he only has 25 carries this season, but has 114 snaps played. Despite playing 30 snaps in Week 9, he was a healthy scratch in Week 10 when the team brought Brooks back. Johnson had started to ascend as the lead back and the team still is not giving up on third-round pick MarShawn Lloyd. Beyond that, he is still on his rookie salary, so the team would have to see him clear waivers. Strong is a journeyman who’s been on three teams in five seasons. He was only brought in because the team lacked depth and needed some help. So he was more likely to clear waivers than Lloyd. With Brooks back into the mix, the team did not have a significant need for a strong either, so if he did end up getting claimed on waivers, it would not have been a big loss. Packers Add Strong Back to Practice Squad The news is likely not good for the status of Jacobs playing in Week 11. Green Bay will lean on Johnson, with Lloyd as the backup and Brooks as the third-down back. Adding Strong is depth because they do not plan to have any with Jacobs out. Now that he has re-signed with the team, they can use three practice squad elevations on him before they have to decide to bring him back onto the active roster. If Jacobs is out, they have a chance to use one of them on Strong in Week 12. Releasing Johnson is a good sign that Micah Parsons will be back this week, as the team does not need depth on the edge anymore. Green Bay faces the Rams in Week 12. We will see if Strong gets called up and if Jacobs is active. This article was originally published on HEAVY The post Packers Sign Familiar Face Amid Josh Jacobs Injury Questions

item.title: Ohio State’s Ryan Day Buyout, Contract in Focus After Nebraska Loss
item.description: LINCOLN, NEBRASKA - NOVEMBER 21: Head coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes stands with the team before the game against the Nebraska Cornhuskers at Memorial Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Lincoln, Nebraska. (Photo by Steven Branscombe/Getty Images) Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO - NOVEMBER 14: Head coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes follows gameplay during the first quarter of a game against the Northwestern Wildcats at Ohio Stadium on November 14, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO - NOVEMBER 7: Head Coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes talks with the referees during a timeout in the second quarter of the game against the Oregon Ducks at Ohio Stadium on November 7, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) Getty The Ohio State Buckeyes have now lost four games this season. That simply doesn’t happen in Columbus, and that means Ryan Day’s job is in jeopardy, even if a buyout of his contract probably remains unlikely. There are certainly some OSU fans who are likely fed up with Day. There are surely others who are giving him a pass this season because starting quarterback Julian Sayin got hurt, and three of Ohio State’s losses have come since then. Either way, it’s been an uglier season than anyone at Ohio State has had to deal with in a long time. They won’t be going to the College Football Playoff. Their last chance to gain some grace will come on Saturday, Nov. 28 when they host archrival Michigan for The Game. A win over the Wolverines will make everything feel a bit better. A loss? Day would be in major trouble if Ohio State doesn’t beat Michigan on Saturday. Ryan Day Contract Details Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO – NOVEMBER 14: Head coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes follows gameplay during the first quarter of a game against the Northwestern Wildcats at Ohio Stadium on November 14, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) Ryan Day’s current contract stems from a seven-year contract extension he signed in February 2025. It runs through the 2031 season, meaning there are five full seasons remaining after 2026. According to CBS Sports , the contract pays Day $12.5 million per year. There are various annual bonuses for titles that can total up to $1.55 million per season, if Day checks all the boxes — spoiler, he won’t be checking all the boxes this season. There’s also a small $250,000 retention bonus that Day can get paid in 2027 if he’s still around. item.content:encoded: LINCOLN, NEBRASKA - NOVEMBER 21: Head coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes stands with the team before the game against the Nebraska Cornhuskers at Memorial Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Lincoln, Nebraska. (Photo by Steven Branscombe/Getty Images) Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO - NOVEMBER 14: Head coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes follows gameplay during the first quarter of a game against the Northwestern Wildcats at Ohio Stadium on November 14, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO - NOVEMBER 7: Head Coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes talks with the referees during a timeout in the second quarter of the game against the Oregon Ducks at Ohio Stadium on November 7, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) Getty The Ohio State Buckeyes have now lost four games this season. That simply doesn’t happen in Columbus, and that means Ryan Day’s job is in jeopardy, even if a buyout of his contract probably remains unlikely. There are certainly some OSU fans who are likely fed up with Day. There are surely others who are giving him a pass this season because starting quarterback Julian Sayin got hurt, and three of Ohio State’s losses have come since then. Either way, it’s been an uglier season than anyone at Ohio State has had to deal with in a long time. They won’t be going to the College Football Playoff. Their last chance to gain some grace will come on Saturday, Nov. 28 when they host archrival Michigan for The Game. A win over the Wolverines will make everything feel a bit better. A loss? Day would be in major trouble if Ohio State doesn’t beat Michigan on Saturday. Ryan Day Contract Details Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO – NOVEMBER 14: Head coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes follows gameplay during the first quarter of a game against the Northwestern Wildcats at Ohio Stadium on November 14, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) Ryan Day’s current contract stems from a seven-year contract extension he signed in February 2025. It runs through the 2031 season, meaning there are five full seasons remaining after 2026. According to CBS Sports , the contract pays Day $12.5 million per year. There are various annual bonuses for titles that can total up to $1.55 million per season, if Day checks all the boxes — spoiler, he won’t be checking all the boxes this season. There’s also a small $250,000 retention bonus that Day can get paid in 2027 if he’s still around. Ryan Day Buyout Details Getty COLUMBUS, OHIO – NOVEMBER 7: Head Coach Ryan Day of the Ohio State Buckeyes talks with the referees during a timeout in the second quarter of the game against the Oregon Ducks at Ohio Stadium on November 7, 2026 in Columbus, Ohio. (Photo by Ben Jackson/Getty Images) For Ohio State to buy Ryan Day out of his contract, it would cost $11.5 million times the remaining years on his contract. So with five years left after this one, it would cost $57.5 million for Day to be bought out after the 2026 season, per CBS Sports. That cost then goes down by $11.5 million each year. For example, if Day was bought out after 2027, it’d be a $46 million buyout. The contract does also have a mitigation clause that can offset some of the buyout amount if Day takes another coaching job. It’s a hefty cost, but Ohio State is one of the schools that would have the money to pay this price if the Buckeyes decided that’s what had to be done. item.title: PSG confirm another devastating, season-ending injury to first team star
item.description: PSG confirm another devastating, season-ending injury to first team star PSG have lost another one of their key players to injury, with devastating news about Desire Doue coming out this afternoon. If you enjoy PSG Talk coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. Things have taken a dramatic negative turn for PSG. Desire Doue went off injured against Nice yesterday afternoon, looking in great pain. Today, the club have confirmed everyone’s worst fears – the attack has ruptured the ACL in his right knee. The Parisians were already without Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, who suffered the same injury a month ago. Losing one world class attacker was bad, but the quality the team have in attack meant it wasn’t an impossible objective. Now, without two of them, the season looks very different. Ligue 1 is still of course likely to be a cruise as it so often is. But the chances of a third consecutive Champions League have dropped precipitously. PSG new arrivals must step up earlier than expected Mika Godts playing for Belgium. (Photo by Marco Rosi/Getty Images) PSG added Mika Godts and Maghnes Akliouche in attack this summer. They were expected to be worked in gradually, but both will now be playing in almost every game now. The pressure is also now on fellow summer arrival Ferran Torres, who has had a quiet spell and will now need to step up to a world class level. In other news… Lucas Digne was left out of the PSG squad to face Nice, another sign of how badly things have gone since his transfer. Luis Enrique has confirmed that Ousmane Dembele is fit to play in today’s game . Reporters claim that Lucas Chevalier has not asked to leave PSG in January, despite rumours to the contrary.

item.title: Soccer Player Leandro Paredes Faints During Live TV Interview After Team’s Latest Win
item.description: Leandro Paredes during the TV interview, Leandro Paredes fainting during the TV interview. Credit: DSports/X NEED TO KNOW Soccer player Leandro Paredes fainted during a live TV interview on Saturday, Nov. 21 The incident occurred after Boca Juniors’ 2-0 win against Atlético Mineiro Club at the Copa Sudamericana in Colombia Paredes, 32, cited “dizziness” as the cause of his collapse Soccer player Leandro Paredes fainted during a live TV interview after winning his latest match. On Saturday, Nov. 21, the Boca Juniors captain, 32, collapsed mid-segment while discussing his team’s 2-0 win against Atlético Mineiro Club at the Copa Sudamericana in Barranquilla, Colombia. The incident occurred amid hot and humid conditions in the country, The Independent reported. In a TikTok video posted by the French outlet Le Parisien , Paredes can be seen talking to a reporter before keeling over and falling to the ground. The reporter rushed over and tried to catch the player while still holding his microphone. In another clip, Paredes lies on the ground while surrounded by staff members, as a man checks his vitals. He then rubs his eyes and lifts his head, still remaining on the ground. Paredes was eventually escorted off the pitch for further medical checks. EL SUSTO DE PAREDES Leandro lo dejó todo, hasta la última gota de esfuerzo, y en la nota con @m_benedetto se desvaneció. El capitán de Boca está bien y se retiró de la nota por sus propios medios. CONMEBOL #SudamericanaEnDSPORTS pic.twitter.com/WXl3yxygUX — DSPORTS (@DSports) November 22, 2026 Paredes later assured fans that he was okay through a post on his Instagram Stories. He shared a photo of himself smiling while lying on a bed. “We’re doing great, babe. Go Boca! Today and always,” he wrote over the snapshot. The Argentine soccer player confirmed in another Instagram post that he collapsed due to a spell of “dizziness.” “We are champions @bocajrs. Thanks to everyone for the messages; it was just a dizziness from so many turns together,” Paredes said. Leandro Paredes receives medical attention after fainting during an interview after winning the Copa Sudamericana 2026 match in Colombia on Nov. 21 Credit: Heberth Santiago/Eurasia Sport Images/Getty The athlete returned for his team’s celebrations later that evening. item.title: Real Madrid fans up in arms over goal that sparked Barcelona comeback vs Villarreal
item.description: Real Madrid fans up in arms over goal that sparked Barcelona comeback vs Villarreal Supporters of Real Madrid have on Sunday taken firm aim at the standard of officiating in La Liga. This comes amid claims that arch rivals Barcelona secured a crucial advantage courtesy of a mistake en route to their comeback victory over Villarreal. Hansi Flick’s troops marked their return to action a short time ago, kicking the defence of their Spanish top-flight title back into gear in a meeting with the aforementioned Villarreal. Inside the opening seven minutes, Barcelona found themselves trailing by two goals to nil. A 2nd-half explosion, however, ultimately gave rise to a 3-2 Blaugrana triumph. The Catalans’ comeback was kicked into gear courtesy of a fine Gerard Martín header, at the end of a cleverly worked corner routine. As alluded to above, though, those of a Real Madrid persuasion are adamant that a corner should never have been awarded in the first place. After João Cancelo took aim at goal from distance, the ball crashed off the post and behind. It initially appeared as though the ball had taken a touch on the way through, though replays were more unclear. Real Madrid’s fans, though, appear nothing short of certain that a goal-kick was the correct decision, widely highlighting an unfair advantage gained by their bitter rivals amid the tight La Liga title race: Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Pedri 9, Yamal 9 | Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal: Player Ratings
item.description: Pedri 9, Yamal 9 | Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal: Player Ratings Barcelona returned from the international break and played their first game of the next phase of the season against Villarreal on Sunday afternoon at the Spotify Camp Nou. They began the game completely dominated and overwhelmed by Villarreal’s energy – something they simply could not keep up with. By half-time, they were 2-0 down, and seemed to have no solutions. Hansi Flick made no panic changes even at half-time, and trusted the same XI. They repaid his faith with a great comeback. Goals from Gerard Martin and Fermin Lopez helped Barcelona get level, and an own goal from Pau Navarro helped them get ahead. Eventually, they held on to the lead and saw the game off to earn all three points. Barça Universal brings you the player ratings from Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal. Joan Garcia: 6 Joan Garcia conceded two goals in the opening ten minutes, and while he was indeed let down by the defence, there is a feeling he could have done a bit more. Neither of the two strikes that resulted in goals for Villarreal came from particularly close range, and the goalkeeper looked helpless in both cases. At least one of the two, given Garcia’s calibre, should have been parried away. Joao Cancelo: 6 Cancelo continued to look like a shadow of his former self, as he has in recent games. He did not show much personality going forward, and his link-up play was sub-par. Even his defensive work rate was relatively questionable, and it is high time some questions begin being asked about his regular starter status given his form. Gerard Martin: 7.5 A rare goal for Gerard Martin. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Gerard Martin, as part of the central defence, holds much of the accountability for the two early goals conceded, especially given that he was the only natural centre-back starting. His distribution under the Villarreal press was underwhelming, and his positioning for both of the opposition’s early strikes was poor. Made up for his poor first half with an improved showing after the break and a great goal to open the scoring for Barcelona. Frenkie de Jong: 8 Despite playing out of position, De Jong seemed to contribute more to Barcelona’s stability than the rest of the defence combined as he shone with the ball and helped retain it on a night where the Catalans struggled for order. The Dutchman was confident on the ball and made the right defensive decisions more often than not. Continued to grow into the second half and finished the game as one of the best players on the field. Eric Garcia: 7 Eric Garcia made his return from injury and was decent at right-back, although Villarreal’s second goal did come from a through ball down his wing. He did more than Cancelo in attack, but was still nowhere close to his best. Contributed to Barcelona’s winning goal with a good cross into the area that the Villarreal defence struggled to deal with. Marc Bernal: 6 The academy star was perhaps the single-most disappointing

They began the game completely dominated and overwhelmed by Villarreal’s energy – something they simply could not keep up with. By half-time, they were 2-0 down, and seemed to have no solutions. Goals from Gerard Martin and Fermin Lopez helped Barcelona get level, and an own goal from Pau Navarro helped them get ahead. Eventually, they held on to the lead and saw the game off to earn all three points. Barça Universal brings you the player ratings from Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal. Joan Garcia: 6 Joan Garcia conceded two goals in the opening ten minutes, and while he was indeed let down by the defence, there is a feeling he could have done a bit more. Even his defensive work rate was relatively questionable, and it is high time some questions begin being asked about his regular starter status given his form. Gerard Martin: 7.5 A rare goal for Gerard Martin. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Gerard Martin, as part of the central defence, holds much of the accountability for the two early goals conceded, especially given that he was the only natural centre-back starting. His distribution under the Villarreal press was underwhelming, and his positioning for both of the opposition’s early strikes was poor. Made up for his poor first half with an improved showing after the break and a great goal to open the scoring for Barcelona. Frenkie de Jong: 8 Despite playing out of position, De Jong seemed to contribute more to Barcelona’s stability than the rest of the defence combined as he shone with the ball and helped retain it on a night where the Catalans struggled for order. The Dutchman was confident on the ball and made the right defensive decisions more often than not. Continued to grow into the second half and finished the game as one of the best players on the field. Eric Garcia: 7 Eric Garcia made his return from injury and was decent at right-back, although Villarreal’s second goal did come from a through ball down his wing. He did more than Cancelo in attack, but was still nowhere close to his best. Contributed to Barcelona’s winning goal with a good cross into the area that the Villarreal defence struggled to deal with. Marc Bernal: 6 The academy star was perhaps the single-most disappointing player of the entire first half as he showed no personality in holding on to possession or breaking down Villarreal’s possession. Bernal was often too slow, his decision-making a tad bit underwhelming, and he did not look anywhere progressive in possession. Improved after the break and circulated the ball better. Fermin Lopez: 7.5 Fermin netted the equalizer. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Fermin’s afternoon began in the worst manner possible as he directly gave the ball away for Villarreal’s opening goal by putting it straight in the path of the opposition forward. He also looked far from his best, made loose passes and did not get into any major goalscoring positions. Made up for his errors with a great goal to put Barcelona level in the second half. Pedri: 9 Pedri, who normally remains Barcelona’s bright spark on dark nights, himself started off the game against Villarreal shaky. He did, however, recover soon and began controlling the midfield for his side. Matters improved for Barcelona after he took control, and he bossed the field thereafter. Assisted Gerard Martin for Barcelona’s first goal, was magical in the play for the second, and was in complete control of matters. Karim Adeyemi: 6 Adeyemi started against Villarreal amid reports of him being very impressive in training, but his performance was anything but indicative of the same. He was energetic, but far from effective and often made poor decisions on the ball. Raphinha: 6.5 Raphinha constantly looked to get into goalscoring positions against the Yellow Submarines, but could not find the right finish. His press was impressive as always, but he should have insisted on taking the penalty given the wind and the pressure at the time of the spot-kick. Lamine Yamal: 9 The combination behind the winner. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Barcelona’s best player of the first half, ironically, was also the player who missed the biggest chance and failed to convert from the penalty spot, leaving his performance as a mixed bag. While he was the only player who showed personality and stepped up his game, his first half was average in terms of the final product. Earned the assist for Fermin’s goal and created Barcelona’s winning goal completely on his own with a stunning back-heel assist.

item.title: Zaire Franklin explains how a “Freak accident” left him with a broken leg
item.description: Green Bay Packers linebacker Zaire Franklin has been sidelined since October after suffering a shin injury during practice. He has spent the past several weeks working toward a return and rejoined the team on the practice field Saturday. Speaking with reporters afterward, Franklin described the incident as a “freak accident” and detailed how the injury happened, according to ESPN’s Rob Demovsky. “Somebody just kind of kneed me in a weird way. I’m thinking it’s just dead leg. I actually finished practice. I practiced two more periods on a broken leg. And then once I got the X-ray and it was broke, I was looking like, I almost couldn’t believe it. It just looked fake,” Franklin remarked via ESPN’s Rob Demovsky. Zaire Franklin with the Packers Oct 18, 2026; Green Bay, Wisconsin, USA; Green Bay Packers Kamal Hadden (36) celebrates with Zaire Franklin (44) and Isaiah McDuffie (58) against Dallas Cowboys at Lambeau Field at Lambeau Field. Mandatory Credit: Ross Harried-Imagn Images At 30, Franklin brings Pro Bowl experience from his 2024 selection and spent the 2018 through 2025 seasons with the Indianapolis Colts. He made an immediate impression after joining Green Bay this year, but his shin injury has restricted him to six appearances. After spending weeks away from the field, the veteran linebacker is clearly pleased to be back practicing with the team. Oct 11, 2026; Green Bay, Wisconsin, USA; Green Bay Packers linebacker Zaire Franklin (44) reacts after a play against the Chicago Bears during the second quarter at Lambeau Field. Mandatory Credit: Mike Dinovo-Imagn Images “The only thing that was going through my mind was, ‘Damn, I can’t practice tomorrow?’ It’s been a journey but I’m glad we were able to push through. Thank God for keeping my head down and really been leaning on my family. I’m just glad to be back.” The Packers are set to visit the Los Angeles Rams on Wednesday for their next contest. The game is scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. ET in Inglewood, California, with both teams entering the matchup holding identical 6-4 records. item.title: Liverpool v Manchester United: Premier League – live
item.description: Premier League updates from the 4.30pm GMT kick-off Live scores | Latest table | And follow us over on TikTok The first day in a new job is supposed to be gentle and relaxed: small talk, smaller admin, a few bits of work and some lamentably awkward handshakes. Mauricio Pochettino’s first day* as Manchester United manager is the polar opposite. Liverpool away, the ultimate domestic challenge for any United manager. This quirk of employment opportunity and fixture list might be a good thing for Pochettino. It’s a free hit, with nobody of sound mind expecting his brave new world to begin until he has had months on the training ground. Mauricio Pochettino’s first day* as Manchester United manager is the polar opposite. Liverpool away, the ultimate domestic challenge for any United manager. This quirk of employment opportunity and fixture list might be a good thing for Pochettino. It’s a free hit, with nobody of sound mind expecting his brave new world to begin until he has had months on the training ground. And if United do win, it’ll increase the length of the free pass that every new manager receives. Continue reading...

item.title: The football superstar-turned-BookTuber who made an obscure Tolstoy novella a belated bestseller
item.description: Once named the best player in Brazil, Gustavo Scarpa’s literature obsession has inspired thousands to become bookworms Julián Scatolaro noticed something odd was occurring when several people came into his bookshop over the space of a few days, all asking for Leo Tolstoy’s novella The Death of Ivan Ilyich . The 35-year-old, who owns a bookshop in the small Argentine city of Chajarí, 311 miles from Buenos Aires, said the sudden interest in a book written in 1886 was surprising enough. But this was particularly strange because when his customers ask for works by the Russian writer, they usually want War and Peace . In a video he posted about the mystery, he called it the “ Tolstoy enigma ”. Continue reading...

item.title: 2027: Any party saying I’ve stepped down is working for Tinubu - Atiku
item.description: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has accused political parties spreading claims that he has withdrawn from the 2027 presidential race of working in favour of President Bola Tinubu. Atiku described the reports as false and insisted that he remained in the contest to win the election. In a statement issued on Sunday by his Director of Strategic Communication, Phrank Shaibu, the former vice-president said no group claiming to be his supporters had the authority to announce his withdrawal. “Any party promoting the lie that I have stepped down is doing Tinubu’s work. Every false withdrawal story tries to clear his strongest opponent from the field,” he said. Atiku added that he had not made any decision to leave the race, dismissing claims attributed to individuals presenting themselves as his supporters. “Putting my name on a placard does not make someone my supporter. Putting a lie in that person’s mouth does not make it my decision,” he said. He warned that any attempt to remove him from the contest through fabricated declarations would deny Nigerians the opportunity to choose their preferred candidate. “If I am not on the ballot, Bola Tinubu might as well wait for a coronation. But I am in this race to win, and Nigerians will have their choice,” he said. The former vice-president also accused those behind the reports of using misinformation to weaken the opposition, alleging that the tactic was intended to benefit the ruling All Progressives Congress. He urged opposition parties seeking to defeat Tinubu to focus on persuading voters rather than circulating claims about rival candidates. “Anyone serious about defeating the APC should take their case to voters. Manufacturing supporters and circulating false declarations will not defeat Tinubu. It only serves him,” Atiku said. On his campaign activities, Atiku said his Affordable Life agenda remained focused on addressing the economic difficulties confronting Nigerian households. He cited the rising cost of food and transportation as issues his campaign intended to address, saying the campaign was reaching communities across the country. “Hunger and poverty are not on social media. They are in our markets, our homes and every community where families struggle to afford food and transport,” he said. Atiku urged his supporters to remain mobilised ahead of the election and ensure they had their Permanent Voter Cards. He reiterated that he would not withdraw in favour of any other candidate, declaring that the contest would be decided by voters. “I do not need anyone to step down for me, and I am stepping down for no one,” he said. The statement concluded with Atiku expressing confidence that he would defeat Tinubu at the ballot box on January 16, 2027. The post 2027: Any party saying I’ve stepped down is working for Tinubu - Atiku appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Fernandes puts Man Utd contract talks on hold
item.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes (Glyn KIRK) Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes has revealed it is "not the right time" for talks over a new contract with his troubled club. Fernandes's future at Old Trafford has been a source of constant doubt in recent years and the speculation that he is ready to quit United continues to swirl. With his current deal due to expire at the end of the season, the 32-year-old has turned down a second offer of a new contract. Fernandes snubbed the chance to move to Saudi Arabian side Al-Hilal in the close-season, but with United in turmoil this term, he is not ready to reopen contract talks with the club he joined in 2020. "The club offered me a new contract, so I think that, from their side, shows that they want me to stay," Fernandes told Sky Sports on Sunday. "There's no negotiations ongoing, but I've seen people saying that 'he's asked for more money, he's asked for more years'. If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here. "I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United. I could have been in a place that is much warmer than Manchester. "Two summers ago, three summers ago, last summer, I always had the chance to leave and I always chose to be here. "I've always showed how much I care about this club and how much I want to win at this club. I've always said, the moment the club thinks it's time for me to move on, I will move on." The Portugal midfielder's form has dipped this season and he has only managed one goal and assist since his hat-trick against Ipswich in August. Fernandes was dropped by Michael Carrick earlier this season after criticising his tactics. Carrick has since been sacked, with Mauricio Pochettino hired to lift United away from the relegation zone. Often criticised for his emotional outbursts and body language on the pitch, Fernandes is keeping his focus on United's cause for now as they start a new era under former USA coach Pochettino. "We spoke about the contract at the end of last season. We came in at the beginning of this season speaking about the contract," Fernandes said. "But about the context of the team and the club, I just put that to a side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me, nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations. "The most important thing now is that the club gets back to winning games." smg/dmc

item.title: This viral star projector has been hyped to Mars and back, but we hunted down the best version you can buy
item.description: It was only a matter of time, but AI has come for astronomy accessories. I’ve yet to see a fictional elderly craftsman begging you to buy his hand-carved telescopes; however, it has absolutely muddied the waters around this viral gooseneck Galaxy Projector Night Light. The good news is that there is an impressive little star projector to be had here, and I’m here to cut through the AI-assisted hype. To make sure you’re not hoodwinked, I’ve done the online legwork to bring you the best version of this device, and it won’t cost you a fortune to put a planetarium in your pocket. Before we dive into what makes this Galaxy Projector Night Light so great, there are a couple of pressing issues to address. No variant of this USB-powered star projector will break up heated dinner arguments by casting a beautifully animated space whale on the ceiling, as one ridiculous AI-generated advert asserts. Its projections are eye-catching enough to entertain space fans young and old, but they’re strictly static. Also, while you might be tempted by the lure of 24 interchangeable slides, compared to this Galaxy Projector Night Light’s 13, this lesser model’s slide selection is a letdown. Not only are the slides smaller and blurrier than this model, a large number are dedicated to seasonal holidays. As much as I enjoy Christmas, if I had Santa’s colossal face gazing down at me from the ceiling I’d never sleep again. Zanbix 2 in 1 Galaxy Projector Night Light review More than meets the eye Aside from the projector itself, the Zanbix 2 in 1 Galaxy Projector Night Light includes 13 swappable slides, crammed into a compact box. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) I tempered my expectations when I first got my hands on the Galaxy Projector Night Light. Packed in a small, relatively unassuming box, it looks remarkably similar to the standard model that’s spread across TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and so on. Just like that one, it’s powered via USB, with a flexible stalk, a slot for slides and a nose-mounted focus wheel. However, once I hooked it up to a handy USB socket, all my reservations vanished, and I was seriously impressed by the power of this little projector. You’ll need a darkened room but the Galaxy Projector Night Light’s larger lens is a serious step-up from the run-of-the-mill version. Its images are richer and clearer than you’d expect from a projector this size, and easily capable of transforming a mid-sized ceiling or wall into a cosmic display. This stunning image of the Pillars of Creation originally came from the James Webb Space Telescope. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) This stunning James Webb Space Telescope image of the Pillars of Creation, with its vast columns of gas and dust, is a perfect example of the projections on offer. The fact the display was static didn’t diminish its wow factor, and I spent a good 15 minutes gazing at it in wonder. The Galaxy Projector Night Light does have a four-hour shut-off in case you drift off or want to use it
item.dc:creator: Chris McMullen
item.content:encoded: It was only a matter of time, but AI has come for astronomy accessories. I’ve yet to see a fictional elderly craftsman begging you to buy his hand-carved telescopes; however, it has absolutely muddied the waters around this viral gooseneck Galaxy Projector Night Light. The good news is that there is an impressive little star projector to be had here, and I’m here to cut through the AI-assisted hype. To make sure you’re not hoodwinked, I’ve done the online legwork to bring you the best version of this device, and it won’t cost you a fortune to put a planetarium in your pocket. Before we dive into what makes this Galaxy Projector Night Light so great, there are a couple of pressing issues to address. No variant of this USB-powered star projector will break up heated dinner arguments by casting a beautifully animated space whale on the ceiling, as one ridiculous AI-generated advert asserts. Its projections are eye-catching enough to entertain space fans young and old, but they’re strictly static. Also, while you might be tempted by the lure of 24 interchangeable slides, compared to this Galaxy Projector Night Light’s 13, this lesser model’s slide selection is a letdown. Not only are the slides smaller and blurrier than this model, a large number are dedicated to seasonal holidays. As much as I enjoy Christmas, if I had Santa’s colossal face gazing down at me from the ceiling I’d never sleep again. Zanbix 2 in 1 Galaxy Projector Night Light review More than meets the eye Aside from the projector itself, the Zanbix 2 in 1 Galaxy Projector Night Light includes 13 swappable slides, crammed into a compact box. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) I tempered my expectations when I first got my hands on the Galaxy Projector Night Light. Packed in a small, relatively unassuming box, it looks remarkably similar to the standard model that’s spread across TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and so on. Just like that one, it’s powered via USB, with a flexible stalk, a slot for slides and a nose-mounted focus wheel. However, once I hooked it up to a handy USB socket, all my reservations vanished, and I was seriously impressed by the power of this little projector. You’ll need a darkened room but the Galaxy Projector Night Light’s larger lens is a serious step-up from the run-of-the-mill version. Its images are richer and clearer than you’d expect from a projector this size, and easily capable of transforming a mid-sized ceiling or wall into a cosmic display. This stunning image of the Pillars of Creation originally came from the James Webb Space Telescope. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) This stunning James Webb Space Telescope image of the Pillars of Creation, with its vast columns of gas and dust, is a perfect example of the projections on offer. The fact the display was static didn’t diminish its wow factor, and I spent a good 15 minutes gazing at it in wonder. The Galaxy Projector Night Light does have a four-hour shut-off in case you drift off or want to use it to lull a child to sleep (and 12 hours for its night light function). It’s easy to adjust thanks to its flexible neck, and while it never once came loose, you’ll find some USB ports have a tighter grip than others. Slide selection Of this projector’s 13 slides, 10 feature astronomy-related images, such as a black hole and the Pillars of Creation. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) Once I set aside the images of Santa Claus (you’re staying in the box, Saint Nick), jellyfish and a T. rex, I was left with 10 astronomy-related slides. Several, such as the black hole, are artistic illustrations, while others, like the aforementioned Pillars, are actual astronomical images. They all have their own distinct appeal. I wouldn’t, for example, describe the black hole slide as relaxing, but it’s absolutely captivating in a cosmic horror way. I’d have appreciated an auto-rotate option, but that would have added some bulk to the projector. Switching slides is a breeze, each image mounted in its own slide holder. Oddly, a couple of mine had hair-like marks, but those disappeared when I brought the image into focus via the nose wheel. Don't have a laptop or USB charger handy? This projector will happily run off a powerbank. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) The full 13-slide set is: • Angel and stars (B&W) • Black hole • Earth and moon • Jellyfish • Magellanic Cloud • Milky Way • Moon and stars (B&W) • Pillars of Creation • Santa • Solar system • Starfield (B&W) • T. rex • Whale and stars (B&W) It’s mildly disappointing that there aren’t extra slide packs out there, but the selection is ample for entertainment, relaxation and even education. What better way to spark an interest in STEM than with the wonders of space? Portable projection The standard gooseneck projector on the left, with the better, larger-lens model on the right. (Image credit: Chris McMullen) The Galaxy Projector Night Light will run off any USB port: a laptop, desktop, charger and so on. I even got it working with my TV’s USB socket, but the real bonus was realizing I could run it off the best power banks . If you’re on the move, slip the projector and slides into one pocket, a powerbank into another, and you’re good to go for hours. Some of the best star projectors are styled so they blend in with a room, but this one is so small you can just pack it away until you need it. The projector’s marketing even advertises it for use in the car, which seems like an accident waiting to happen. Only the Blisslights Starport is smaller, but then you’re limited to laser-dot stars. There’s no remote and no sound options, but the Galaxy Projector Night Light is so easy to use that children should be able to get to grips with it. Literally, in fact, since while the light portion warms up, it never really gets hot. Factor in its small size and pocket-friendly price, and it’s an ideal space gift or stocking stuffer for a young stargazer. The "black hole" slide is an illustration rather than a photograph, but impressive all the same (Image credit: Chris McMullen) As long as you don’t buy the hype and think you’re getting something that’ll bathe a room in beautifully animated starscapes, as several Amazon purchasers did, you’ll find this Galaxy Projector Night Light is a surprisingly capable little star projector. Are there bigger and better models out there? Yes, and we’ve rounded up the best star projectors if this one isn’t for you. But for convenience, value for money and portability, this Galaxy Projector Night Light is a great way to bring the cosmos into your home and it’s fast cemented itself as one of my favorites.

item.title: Death Toll From Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 29
item.description: The death toll from Friday’s boat accident in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State has risen to 29, with over 50 survivors receiving treatment in hospitals. Governor Douye Diri disclosed this during a condolence visit by Vice President Kashim Shettima. Diri explained that the final casualty figure had yet to be established as efforts were still ongoing to recover the affected vessel. ﻿ He, however, said some passengers might still be trapped inside the boat. The governor described the incident as avoidable, alleging that the boat was not fit for river travel and had operated from an unauthorised loading point. He said the state government had taken responsibility for the medical bills and feeding of the survivors. Diri thanked President Tinubu for the concern shown by the Presidency since the incident occurred, particularly the Vice President’s visit to the state. He used the occasion to appeal for Federal Government support for the construction of more roads across Bayelsa, noting that improved road access would reduce the dependence of some communities on water transportation. The accident occurred on Friday, November 20, 2026, when a boat conveying mourners to a burial ceremony capsized near Oweikorogha Community in the Ukubie area of Southern Ijaw. The Bayelsa State Police Command confirmed the incident in a statement, adding that the boat was travelling from Ayama Community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony on Friday, when it capsized at about 11 a.m. The boat developed a mechanical fault while navigating the waterways, according to a preliminary police report. Following the incident, rescue operations were launched, with several passengers rescued while others were initially reported missing. A survivor had also alleged that the wooden passenger boat, popularly known as a ‘love boat’, was overloaded with passengers and their belongings. President Bola Tinubu expressed condolences to the families of the victims, describing the incident as tragic and directing relevant federal disaster response agencies to support rescue and recovery efforts. He also approved ₦250 million in support for the families of the victims. The post Death Toll From Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 29 appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: GTA 6 Players Keep Discovering Ridiculous New Ways To Steal Money

item.title: Awoyaya explosion: Doherty accuses Lagos APM guber candidate of plagiarising his statement
item.description: The Lagos State governorship candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, Funso Doherty, has accused his Action Peoples Movement counterpart, Laja Laoye, of plagiarising his statement on the Awoyaya filling station explosion. Doherty made the allegation in a post on X on Sunday, after accusing Laoye of reproducing almost identical wording in his reaction to the incident, which occurred on Saturday, November 21. One person was reportedly killed after fire engulfed Sunbeth filling station at Awoyaya bus stop in the Ibeju-Lekki area of Lagos. Videos circulating on social media showed a tanker catching fire within the filling station before an explosion, while people and vehicles were seen close to the scene. Doherty had earlier reacted to the incident in a post on X at 10:09 am on Sunday, expressing sympathy for those affected and calling for measures to prevent a recurrence. “I was saddened to learn of the explosion and fire in the Awoyaya area of Lagos this weekend. As more details emerge about this unfortunate incident, our thoughts and prayers are with those who were injured and those who have suffered devastating loss,” he wrote. I was saddened to learn of the explosion and fire in the Awoyaya area of Lagos this weekend. As more details emerge about this unfortunate incident, our thoughts and prayers are with those who were injured and those who have suffered devastating loss. As we lend a hand of… — funsodoherty (@funsodoherty) November 22, 2026 He added that authorities should investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident, learn from it and take corrective action. “As we lend a hand of solidarity, sympathy and assistance to all those affected, we must also quickly work to understand why this occurred, learn from it, take remedial steps and institute punitive measures where appropriate to prevent future occurrences,” Doherty said. About an hour later, at 11:01 am, Laoye published his own statement on the explosion, also expressing sympathy for victims and calling for an investigation into its cause. In his post, the APM candidate wrote: “I was deeply saddened to learn of the explosion and fire that occurred in the Awoyaya area of Lagos this weekend. item.title: 'Star Trek: First Contact' at 30: Director Jonathan Frakes reflects on his triumphant time-travel blockbuster (interview)
item.description: null " Star Trek: First Contact " celebrates its 30th anniversary today, and the engaging sci-fi classic still looks fantastic three decades later. With the sad passing of its star, Patrick Stewart , last month, and "Star Trek's" milestone 60th birthday taking place in 2026, this is a bittersweet salute that also holds an extra special significance. Directed by "The Next Generation's" Number One, Jonathan Frakes , in his feature film debut, " First Contact " consistently ranks as one of the finest "Star Trek" feature films among fans and critics, and those accolades are well deserved. Based on a compelling screenplay by Brannon Braga and Ronald D. Moore, "First Contact" remains as bright and beautiful as ever, brimming with bravado, heart, horror, and heroism. Not only was it a bona fide crowdpleaser when it was released by Paramount over Thanksgiving week on Nov. 22, 1996, but it was also a financial success for the studio, eventually pulling in a worldwide total of $212 million off a modest $45 million budget. Honestly, who can forget Alice Krige's seductive Borg Queen, Marina Sirtis’ Deana Troi tipsy on tequila, Brent Spiner's Data feeling the sensation of human skin, Patrick Stewart’s Jean-Luc Picard reliving past traumas, and James Cromwell's Zephram Cochrane blasting off in the Phoenix and dancing to Roy Orbison's "Ooby Dooby"? We caught up with Frakes for "First Contact's" 30th anniversary to hear why this "Trek" treasure holds up and warp back to Hollywood’s heyday of the '90s. Resistance is futile! "What’s not to love?" Frakes tells SPACE regarding the film’s lasting popularity. "It was bulletproof. Dean Devlin ["Stargate," "Independence Day"] and I have very similar sensibilities about filmmaking. We like the whole idea of action, adventure, comedy, and in the case of 'First Contact,' a little horror as well. ILM’s John Knoll, the guy who won the Oscar for 'Star Wars,' just happened to be our Special Effects Supervisor." "Star Trek: First Contact" celebrates its 30th birthday on Nov. 22, 2026. (Image credit: Paramount) "First Contact" is filled with memorable moments and indelible performances, some of which certainly stand out for Frakes looking back over the years on the production. "The two things that always come to mind were the beautiful scene with Alfre [Woodard] and Patrick, the Moby Dick scene, where she says, 'You broke your little ships,'" he recalls. "I was sitting under the camera with my face in my hands, watching two heavyweights go at it take after take. It was what you dream of. They were into it. The writing was great. We had time to do it right, and they were fabulous together. "That and the Cromwell and Marina drunk on tequila scene. It's not only one extended take, but it contributes to the pace of the movie in the right kind of way. My wife tells me that I was really good in that scene because I was exhausted and relaxed. item.content:encoded: null " Star Trek: First Contact " celebrates its 30th anniversary today, and the engaging sci-fi classic still looks fantastic three decades later. With the sad passing of its star, Patrick Stewart , last month, and "Star Trek's" milestone 60th birthday taking place in 2026, this is a bittersweet salute that also holds an extra special significance. Directed by "The Next Generation's" Number One, Jonathan Frakes , in his feature film debut, " First Contact " consistently ranks as one of the finest "Star Trek" feature films among fans and critics, and those accolades are well deserved. Based on a compelling screenplay by Brannon Braga and Ronald D. Moore, "First Contact" remains as bright and beautiful as ever, brimming with bravado, heart, horror, and heroism. Not only was it a bona fide crowdpleaser when it was released by Paramount over Thanksgiving week on Nov. 22, 1996, but it was also a financial success for the studio, eventually pulling in a worldwide total of $212 million off a modest $45 million budget. Honestly, who can forget Alice Krige's seductive Borg Queen, Marina Sirtis’ Deana Troi tipsy on tequila, Brent Spiner's Data feeling the sensation of human skin, Patrick Stewart’s Jean-Luc Picard reliving past traumas, and James Cromwell's Zephram Cochrane blasting off in the Phoenix and dancing to Roy Orbison's "Ooby Dooby"? We caught up with Frakes for "First Contact's" 30th anniversary to hear why this "Trek" treasure holds up and warp back to Hollywood’s heyday of the '90s. Resistance is futile! "What’s not to love?" Frakes tells SPACE regarding the film’s lasting popularity. "It was bulletproof. Dean Devlin ["Stargate," "Independence Day"] and I have very similar sensibilities about filmmaking. We like the whole idea of action, adventure, comedy, and in the case of 'First Contact,' a little horror as well. ILM’s John Knoll, the guy who won the Oscar for 'Star Wars,' just happened to be our Special Effects Supervisor." "Star Trek: First Contact" celebrates its 30th birthday on Nov. 22, 2026. (Image credit: Paramount) "First Contact" is filled with memorable moments and indelible performances, some of which certainly stand out for Frakes looking back over the years on the production. "The two things that always come to mind were the beautiful scene with Alfre [Woodard] and Patrick, the Moby Dick scene, where she says, 'You broke your little ships,'" he recalls. "I was sitting under the camera with my face in my hands, watching two heavyweights go at it take after take. It was what you dream of. They were into it. The writing was great. We had time to do it right, and they were fabulous together. "That and the Cromwell and Marina drunk on tequila scene. It's not only one extended take, but it contributes to the pace of the movie in the right kind of way. My wife tells me that I was really good in that scene because I was exhausted and relaxed. It’s true, you’re exhausted when you’re filming and acting at the same time. I got to sit there and watch those two. It was like watching a tennis game." Jonathan Frakes and James Cromwell in "Star Trek: First Contact" (Image credit: Paramount) Many Trekkies might not know that Alfre Woodard is Frakes' godmother, and he had specifically asked producer Rick Berman for approval to include her in the movie’s cast. "She's one of our finest American actors," he notes. "Rick said, 'If we can get Alfre, that would be great.' I knew she’d do great with Patrick, so that was a no-brainer. I never had a godmother, and when I came out here to live in LA back in 1979, an old friend from college, Nathan Cook, was working with Alfre. We were at a barbecue, and it came up. She said, 'You don’t have a godmother? I’ll be your godmother.' I asked what that meant, and she said, 'I’ll be in charge of your spiritual being.' It's been a magical friendship that turned into her playing that part." The hive-minded cybernetic collective known as the Borg featured prominently in the time-travel tale, and that second filming unit did a masterful job lighting those scenes. "The Borg costumes were torture, from what I was told," says Frakes. "We had our own set of ADs and an entirely separate special effects makeup crew, and the costume department had a certain number of Borg to build and rebuild. Now the Borg had been on the show, but with these Borg we had more time and more moving parts. It was kind of an enhanced thing that really paid off. I look back so fondly on that entire experience. Also, the Borg were one of the great movie villains. They held up!" Frakes couldn’t be prouder of "First Contact", and he reminds us that most people like it right next to 1982's "Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan." That's rarefied air indeed! "We got Cromwell coming off of 'Babe.' So we had Alfre and Alice and Cromwell. They joined our family effortlessly. Because we'd done seven TV seasons, 182 episodes, and a movie already together, we were thick as thieves and still are; may Patrick rest in peace. The three of them joined us as if we’d been dancing with them forever." "Star Trek: First Contact" is available to stream on Paramount+. item.title: "It can take years": Why the AI Riemann proof is far from settled
item.description: AI claimed another major scalp in maths on Friday, as Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge published what he says is a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, a Millennium Prize Problem, in 17 million lines of code that no human has read in full. Physicist Tony Padilla tells Tech 24 that verification could take years, and that Alpöge should share how he got there.

item.title: On this day in space! Nov.22, 1989: NASA launches space shuttle Discovery on classified STS-33 mission for the US military
item.description: null On Nov. 22, 1989, the space shuttle Discovery launched on the secret mission STS-33 for the U.S. military. It lifted off from Kennedy Space Center and up into the dark of night. This was the third nighttime launch of the shuttle program and the 32nd shuttle mission overall. Discovery had five astronauts on board. Their mission was to deploy a classified payload for the U.S. Department of Defense. NASA and the military launched several secretive shuttle missions to deploy military satellites . The satellite that launched with STS-33 is believed to be a type of spy satellite called Magnum. But exactly what Magnum was doing in orbit remains classified. NASA's space shuttle Discovery launches on the classified STS-33 mission for the U.S. military on Nov. 22, 1989. (Image credit: NASA) Why it mattered From its start, the Space Transportation System, better known as the space shuttle, was a compromise between meeting civilian and military needs. NASA saw the vehicle as a means of supporting science research, establishing an on-orbit economy (servicing commercial satellites and flying company payloads) and ultimately, assembling the parts for a space station. The Department of Defense saw the shuttle as an asset to deploying and retrieving reconnaissance satellites, among other projects, some of them classified. It was not until the loss of the space shuttle Challenger, that it was decided that the shuttle would only be used by the military when it was key to national security. Other needs would be met by expendable launch vehicles (ELVs). As an aside, the STS-33 astronauts also spent Thanksgiving in space during this mission. But the holiday was off to a crappy start when the shuttle's toilet broke first thing in the morning. After spending most of the day fixing it, they got to enjoy their Thanksgiving turkey together. Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube .

item.title: Zadok Is Singing About Finding Real Love in His New Single “My Treasure”
item.description: Zadok Aghalengbe drops his new single “My Treasure”, an Afro-fusion, R&B and soul love song. In the mood for a love song that makes you appreciate having that special someone in your life? Zadok Aghalengbe has something new for your playlist. The Nigerian singer and songwriter, who finished as runner-up on Nigerian Idol Season 7, has dropped “My Treasure”, a new single all about love, gratitude and holding on to someone worth keeping. Pulling together Afro-fusion, contemporary R&B and soul, the track puts Zadok’s rich, husky vocals front and centre over a story of devotion and real connection. Dubbed the “Preacher of Love”, he keeps leaning into romantic themes in his music, with “My Treasure” showing his push to make love songs that last. Speaking about the inspiration behind the record, Zadok describes it as a celebration of finding something rare and genuine. He also hopes the song captures the gratitude and connection that come with having someone truly special. Listen below The post Zadok Is Singing About Finding Real Love in His New Single “My Treasure” appeared first on BellaNaija - Showcasing Africa to the world. Read today! .

item.title: Nintendo’s Switch 2 console is $50 off for Black Friday
item.description: Those hoping to save some cash on a Nintendo Switch 2 can do so starting today, November 22nd, through Saturday, December 5th, giving you plenty of time to think about it after Cyber Monday has passed. For a limited time, Nintendo has knocked $50 off one of its two current console bundles, temporarily rolling back the $50 price increase that went into effect in early September. It’s tough to predict which bundle will be most popular for your household. The Mario Kart World bundle runs $499.99 (previously $549.99) and includes the console, a digital copy of the aforementioned game, and three months of Nintendo Switch Online. Then there’s the Nintendo Switch Sports Resort bundle for $529.99 (price unchanged for Black Friday), which includes the more recent minigame-filled title instead. Both are currently available from Amazon , Best Buy , Walmart , and Nintendo . Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle Where to Buy: $549.99 $499.99 at Amazon $549.99 $499 at Walmart $549.99 $499.99 at Best Buy Nintendo has delivered hit after hit since the console launched in mid-2025. There are now plenty of excellent games to justify snagging a Switch 2, including, most recently, the stellar remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . Plus, the newer console can play nearly all of the original Switch games, and it’s wirelessly compatible with the older system’s Joy-Con and Switch Pro controllers. If you’re planning to get a Switch 2, below are some useful guides filled with accessory recommendations. From tempered glass screen protectors and protective cases to controllers, there are plenty of goodies that’ll help you take better care of your Switch 2 and get more enjoyment from it.

item.title: ‘The show is starting soon. Please turn on your headphones.’
item.description: Love Me uses Auracast broadcasts both for accessibility and the sound design. | Photo: Curtis Brown Up a few concrete steps and through the front door of a 200-year-old row house in New York City, I follow a crowd of people into the 178-seat SoHo Playhouse. As we filter to our seats, ushers hand each person a black drawstring bag with a pair of wired headphones connected to a small Auracast receiver . Then, soon after the play begins, we're instructed to put them on. The headphones are an integral storytelling tool of Love Me - a one-man show from the minds of stand-up comedian and former Saturday Night Live writer Drew Michael and director Prashanth Venkataramanujam. It's a show about love and the bid for connection, told in five chapters … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: Israel investigates West Bank fires
item.description: Israeli authorities have opened an investigation after Palestinian vehicles and properties were vandalised and set on fire in four villages in the occupied West Bank, in attacks local activists say were carried out by Israeli settlers. Around eight vehicles were reportedly torched and racist slogans sprayed on walls, prompting Israeli soldiers and police to deploy to the area. The attacks come amid a surge in settler violence since the outbreak of the Gaza war in October 2023, with more than 1,100 Palestinians killed by Israeli soldiers or settlers in the West Bank since then, according to an AFP tally. They also follow recent sanctions announced by the UK and Australia against eight Israeli companies involved in settlement activity. France 24 correspondent Noga Tarnopolsky shares further details from Jerusalem.

item.title: “Money in a Wheelbarrow”: Adekunle Gold & Blaqbonez Are Making Big-Money Talk Sound Good
item.description: Artwork for Adekunle Gold and Blaqbonez’s collaboration “Money in a Wheelbarrow”. Did you ever envisage an Adekunle Gold and Blaqbonez collaboration? You’re not alone, neither did we, but as it turns out, “ Money in a Wheelbarrow ” is officially here—and Adekunle Gold shared that this is actually a link-up with an artist who released a diss track about him years ago, plus their second attempt at making a song together. If you enjoy a track with a cheeky backstory behind it, this one is all about celebrating your hard-earned bag, enjoying the fruits of your grind and soaking up good moments right now instead of putting joy off until later. On the song itself, Adekunle Gold brings his smooth, melodic touch alongside Blaqbonez’s witty rap delivery as they trade lines about stacking cash, containers landing in Apapa and living large. You get a lively mix of English, Nigerian Pidgin and Yoruba phrasing that makes you want to sing along fast, turning big-money talk into something bright and upbeat rather than heavy. The visuals match that playful mood right from the start, with bold pixel-style lettering flashing across the screen over a bright backdrop where both artists are dressed in sharp dark suits, ties, sunglasses and stacks of cash. Watching them pose around wheelbarrows piled with money as words like “Wheel Barrow”, “Pack Am O”, “Container”, “Apapa”, “Hosana” and “Duffel Bag” pop up gives the video a fun, tongue-in-cheek edge that keeps your eyes locked on the screen. I f you want a fresh, upbeat tune with a funny plot twist behind it, “Money in a Wheelbarrow” is ready for your playlist. *** Photo Credit: Adekunle Gold/Instagram The post “Money in a Wheelbarrow”: Adekunle Gold & Blaqbonez Are Making Big-Money Talk Sound Good appeared first on BellaNaija - Showcasing Africa to the world. Read today! .

item.title: 2027: Atiku won’t step down for anyone, says Momodu
item.description: Media entrepreneur and publisher of Ovation International, Dele Momodu, has said former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar remains in the 2027 presidential race and has no intention of stepping down for any aspirant. Momodu stated this in a post on his X platform on Sunday, insisting that Atiku was determined to contest the election. “Take it from me as the absolute TRUTH… ATIKU ABUBAKAR is too consequential, experienced and focused to step down for ANYONE,” he wrote. He added that the former vice-president was still firmly in the race and was committed to making life affordable for Nigerians again. “He is very much in the race and ready to make life AFFORDABLE for all NIGERIANS again,” Momodu said. The post 2027: Atiku won’t step down for anyone, says Momodu appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: It Will Be Difficult To Stabilise What Tinubu Has Done If We Don’t Re-Elect Him — Wike
item.description: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has said that denying President Bola Tinubu a second term will amount to abandoning and undermining the positive effects of the various economic reforms and other policies his administration has started to implement. ﻿ Wike argued that though the removal of fuel subsidy came with initial difficulties, it would be in the best interest of Nigeria and its people for the President to complete the foundation he has laid for the country’s recovery and prosperity. He spoke on Sunday during a thanksgiving and dedication service at St. Peter’s Anglican Church, Rumueprikom, his hometown in Obio/Akpor Local Government Area of Rivers State, where the Rainbow Coalition campaign council was dedicated ahead of the 2027 general elections. Wike Wike, who said the campaigns would begin on November 23, described Tinubu as a courageous leader who took difficult decisions to prevent Nigeria from collapsing. “This country was on the verge of collapse, on the verge of collapse, but by the grace of God, He gave us somebody who is courageous,” the former governor said. The minister cited the relative stability in the university system, saying lecturers’ strikes over unpaid entitlements, which previously disrupted academic calendars, are no longer a recurring problem under the Tinubu administration. He also recalled the difficulties pensioners faced in securing their payments, arguing that the President’s decisions were necessary to address the country’s challenges. Wike described the removal of the fuel subsidy as one such difficult decision, acknowledging it came with disadvantages but insisting the challenges were temporary. “Now, in doing that, there must be some disadvantages. “And that’s why they say these disadvantages will be temporarily seen. As he has laid his foundation, now it’s time for prosperity,” he said. “If we don’t re-elect him, then it will be difficult to stabilise what he has done,” he said. The minister called on Christians, Muslims and traditional worshippers to support the re-election bid, insisting that the campaign would not discriminate on religious grounds. “I am not a native doctor, but I need their votes now. I need everybody’s votes because I know they are registered voters,” he added. “The Muslims, I need their votes too. The Christians like you, we need your votes.” Wike also defended the Tinubu administration against claims of religious imbalance in its appointments, saying Christians benefited more from the government than under previous administrations. “Since Nigeria was created, we have never had the kind of appointments that are going on in this country now,” said the minister.
